# Fetch all pages until empty and sum qualifying amounts
all_requests = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    all_requests.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

# Filter and sum
total = 0.0
for req in all_requests:
    created = datetime.strptime(req['created_at'], '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S')
    if start_date <= created <= today:
        total += req['amount']

print("Total requested in last 7 days:", total)
